title: InterGenOS forensic-trace event
description: Canonical schema for every event emitted by scripts/lib/igos_trace.py and scripts/lib/trace.sh. Build pipeline + igos-build + pkm + installer.backend all emit through this same envelope. Cross-file jq joins by .ts / .runid / .pkg / .phase work uniformly because the schema is one schema.

type.description: Event type. Canonical vocabulary documented in dossier 30-lift-plan.md section 2.

ts.description: Event timestamp. ISO-8601 UTC with millisecond precision (YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS.mmmZ). Both Python (igos_trace._iso_ts) and bash (trace.sh:_trace_iso_ts) emit byte-identical format.

runid.description: 16-hex run identifier shared across every event in one build/install. Set via IGOS_TRACE_RUNID env-var inheritance.

phase.description: Optional phase tag (PHASE_* string or pkm_* / igos-build_* operation name).

pkg.description: Optional package name pin. Lets cross-file jq joins by .pkg work uniformly.

tier.description: Optional tier pin (toolchain, core, base, desktop, ai, extra, ch8, ch10, core-extra, bootloader, igos-build).

rc.description: Subprocess / phase / package return code. 0 = success.

duration_ms.description: Duration in milliseconds. Always an integer; matches Python and bash emit shape.

cmd.description: Subprocess argv as an array of strings.

stdout.description: Subprocess stdout captured verbatim (no truncation per byte-level-capture contract).

stdin_bytes.description: Byte length of input stream passed to a subprocess.

redacted_env_keys.description: Names of env-vars whose values were redacted from subprocess_start events. Names land in the trail; values never do (PII/secret hygiene).
